name: Kluse (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kluse (a blue wavy pale between a church and a mill on yellow).
history: The colours gold and red are those of the former prince-bishopric of Münster, to which the former municipalities of Ahlen and Steinbild belonged.

features.role: Kluse arms — wavy pale, church and mill on yellow
